title.en: The cost of a new process

subtitle.zh: 连接变短并不等于制造变简单，高密度连接把多方面的挑战集中在一起。
subtitle.en: Shorter connections do not mean simpler manufacturing; high-density interconnection brings many challenges together.

body.zh: 更短的连接带来更高的性能，同时也付出更复杂的制造、材料、测试与可靠性代价。
body.en: Shorter connections improve performance, while incurring greater manufacturing, materials, testing and reliability costs.
